title: fix(app-shell): disabled Studio Publish gives its nothing-pending reason on hover and keyboard focus
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb6bDc6Eia7WGdAfa8YTp42f)_
Fixes #31495

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio 顶栏的「发布」按钮在没有待发布草稿时,不再只在禁用按钮上挂一个 `title`,而是和只读包状态一样,外面套一层可聚焦的包裹元素:鼠标悬停、键盘 Tab 聚焦都会弹出提示「没有待发布的草稿」,屏幕阅读器也能读到这句原因。
- **为什么改**:原生禁用的按钮收不到悬停和焦点事件,`title` 谁也看不到,Tab 还会直接跳过「发布」;作者不知道按钮为什么是灰的。QA 规则 `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` 要求每个禁用控件都能说明原因。
- **风险与回滚**:只改一个组件的包裹结构,不动文案、不加多语言 key、不碰服务端或 spec。只读包状态和有草稿时的可点击按钮保持原样。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 中 `publishDisabledReason` 与其下方的 Tooltip 包裹;其次是测试文件 `StudioDesignSurface.publishReadOnlyReason-12303.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 describe 块。
- **两分钟验证**:打开一个没有草稿的可写包的 Studio,在「变更」按钮上按一次 Tab,焦点应落在「发布」上并弹出「没有待发布的草稿」提示;鼠标悬停也应出现同一提示。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`StudioDesignSurface` computes one `publishDisabledReason`: the read-only reason (`engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint`) on a read-only package with no pair, else the nothing-pending reason (`engine.studio.publishNoneTitle`) when no draft is pending and no publish is in flight, else none. Whenever there is a reason, Publish is drawn inside the one shared wrapper the read-only state already used: a `tabIndex=0` span marked `data-disabled-reason` that is the Radix tooltip trigger, with the span and the button both pointing `aria-describedby` at an `sr-only` copy of the reason. The button gets `disabled:pointer-events-none` so the wrapper takes the hover. The `title` the disabled button could never show is dropped; an enabled Publish keeps its `engine.studio.publishTitle` title.

The nothing-pending `sr-only` reason moves inside the wrapper and keeps its `publish-none-reason` test id and its id. The read-only branch renders exactly as before (same wrapper, same text, same ids).

A publish in flight gets no wrapper on purpose: the button shows a spinner for the moment the publish runs, which is the host's own transient state and not a condition the author has to act on, so there is no reason to give.

No locale key is added (the existing `engine.studio.publishNoneTitle` is reused). No server or `packages/spec` change.

## Tests

The new pins go into the existing shared harness `StudioDesignSurface.publishReadOnlyReason-12303.test.tsx` as a top-level describe, with a `drafts` ledger the fetch stub now answers:

- no drafts on a writable package: the wrapper is a tab stop; the button carries no `title`; the wrapper and the button are both described by "No drafts pending publish", through the one `publish-none-reason` element; the button lets the hover through;
- hovering the wrapper opens a tooltip with the reason;
- Tab from "Changes" lands on Publish's wrapper and opens the tooltip;
- CONTROL, a draft pending: a plain enabled Publish with no wrapper, no description and no reason text.

Two edits to the file's existing read-only block, both forced by the new behaviour:

- the wait helper now waits for the wrapper to be described by the reason it expects, not for any wrapper, because an empty ledger now wraps Publish in the nothing-pending reason before the package list answers `writable: false`;
- the writable CONTROL leg asserted "no wrapper" on a writable package with an empty ledger, which is exactly the state this card changes. It now asserts that leg gives no read-only reason and that its wrapper carries the nothing-pending reason instead.

Unchanged and green: the objectui#8219 no-draft and pending pins (`StudioDesignSurface.interfacePolish.test.tsx`), the objectui#12517 posture pins (`StudioDesignSurface.publishPosture-12517.test.tsx`), the pending-count pins (`StudioDesignSurface.changesCount-11787.test.tsx`, `StudioDesignSurface.publishCount-11807.test.tsx`).

## Acceptance notes

- While the draft ledger's first read is still on the wire, the surface already treats the package as having nothing pending, so the wrapper and the nothing-pending reason show from first paint until the read answers. This is unchanged from main, where the `sr-only` sentence and the `title` showed in the same window; this PR only gives that state the wrapper.
- When a draft lands while the wrapper has focus, the wrapper is replaced by the plain button, so focus returns to the document body. The read-only wrapper on main behaves the same way when a package turns writable.

## Verification

Head `41c616fc` (fix `0c4adb53`, harness import `d612ad6e`, merge of `origin/main` `41c616fc`, which touched no file under `ui/packages/app-shell`). Branch base `dabef0f66`.

<details><summary>Tests (app-shell, vitest from ui/, under the verify lock)</summary>

- The five Publish files (`StudioDesignSurface.publishReadOnlyReason-12303`, `interfacePolish`, `publishPosture-12517`, `changesCount-11787`, `publishCount-11807`) at `d612ad6e`: Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 27 passed (27).
- 32 neighbour files that import `StudioDesignSurface` and query Publish, a tooltip, Tab order or a `data-disabled-reason` wrapper, at `0c4adb53`: Test Files 32 passed (32), Tests 289 passed (289). The other app-shell suites are CI's Test UI.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 67 tasks, exit 0 (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one leg, committed first, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

The nothing-pending arm of `publishDisabledReason` was replaced by `false` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `5abb9ba96d85` to `f6ae84fc1790`), so a writable package with no drafts gets neither the wrapper nor the reason. Six cases go red: the three new nothing-pending cases, the writable CONTROL leg of the read-only block, the objectui#8219 no-draft pin and the objectui#12517 nothing-pending pin. The three read-only cases and the new pending CONTROL stay green. Restore: blob back to `5abb9ba96d85`, equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import the surface by relative path, so the mutation is read from `src/` with no build in between.

</details>
